draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Great talking with you last week about getting Maple Studio going in Wrenfield. One easy next step: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is usually where things click \u2014 the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that came up since we spoke.

Best,
Nadia
